7496222617053990175.text: In the alleys of TEL Aviv's Carmel Market, next to a bar and a butcher, you'll find the little cafe Fury. Daniel and his partner Yarden, left their work in high tech to start a coffee shop about a year ago in the middle of the war. It was a dream of theirs for a long time. They felt they could bring a lot to the community through this local full of love, and decided it was the right time to take the leap. Of course, I got my usual matcha, but I also got the coolest takeaway iced latte I've ever had in my life. Coffee culture here is taken very seriously. I was once sitting with my friend who ordered a coffee, and I said I had to leave to a meeting soon, and he said, okay, I'll finish my coffee, and then you'll go. But Daniel understood that some coffee is made to be walked with, especially in this amazing weather. So he figured a sealed can is the perfect way to take your favorite coffee to go and have it wherever you want. Not only is Cafe Fiori the only spot in Israel to can their lattes, but they also have one of the best iced lattes that I've tried. 7541775954906041622.text: My Italian friend begged me not to make a TikTok about this restaurant. He was like, we're gonna go to the best hidden gem Italian in London, but only if you don't make a TikTok about it. You had me at the fact that they bring an entire tray of bread round and you can have as much as you want, and it's done with fresh olive oil. Oh, my gosh, it's so good. It's hard to find genuine hidden gem restaurants in London that are actually good, and this hits the spot every time. The burrata is great. I absolutely love Tuscany, and they do the best tomatoes ever in Tuscany, and these are on a par with actual Tuscan tomatoes. I have a soft spot for anywhere that does a good melon and ham, but oh, my goodness. Honorary mention for the aubergine parmigiana. So good. Of course, you have to top with extra Parmesan, because why not? When in Rome, do as the Romans do. The perfect level of cheese to rich sauce ratio. And don't sleep on the zucchini fries. Oh, my gosh, they're so perfectly salty. I was obsessed. I've tried most of the pasta on the menu here, and honestly, every single one is so good. You can just tell that they're so fresh. These are actually the small dishes as well, so the portions are actually really big. I feel like it's one of those restaurants where you can't go wrong. You can Just tell that the pasta been made lovingly that morning in the kitchen. It just hits different. Even the fries are good. They're like triple cooked. And oh my gosh, the seafood platter was so good. Of course you can get the cacio e Pepe in the cheese wheel, which people love. I went for the Dover sole, but my actual favourite pasta is definitely the the vodka pasta, because I just love a vodka pasta. It's perfectly al dente. This restaurant has been around since 1974 and there's a reason for that. Upscale Italian dining, fresh ingredients and such good service. Literally find a lot of Italian restaurants don't have the best service in London, but this is great from start to finish. They even do a hybrid cookie brownie for dessert, which you just have to get. This place is low key authentic and delicious. I judge a place by how good their bread is and how good the tiramisu is. Oh my goodness, this table side tiramisu is so good. Perfectly creamy. It really is one of the best tiramisu in London. I'm more of a cookie brownie girl, so I can't stop dreaming about that, but this tiramisu is great. They also do a really good lemon meringue pie that people are literally obsessed with and travel far and wide for. This is one of London's best hidden gem Italian restaurants for a reason. I absolutely love it. I've never had bad service or a bad Meal here
